Find answers to common questions about Connectly
How do I get started with Connectly?
Simply download the app from the App Store or Google Play, create your account, and complete your professional profile. You can start connecting with others immediately.
Is my data secure on Connectly?
Yes, we use enterprise-grade encryption and security protocols to protect your information. Your privacy is our top priority and we never share your data with third parties.
Can I use Connectly on multiple devices?
Absolutely! Connectly syncs seamlessly across all your devices including smartphones, tablets, and computers. Your connections and conversations are always up to date.
What makes Connectly different from other networking apps?
Connectly focuses on quality connections over quantity. Our intelligent matching system helps you connect with professionals who share your interests and goals.
Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time with no penalties. If you cancel within 30 days, you'll receive a full refund under our money-back guarantee.
We provide email support for all users and priority support for Professional and Enterprise plan subscribers. Our team typically responds within 24 hours.
